title: Christmas Eve Brunch
seo_title: Christmas Eve Brunch at Vineyard Market in Ozark, MO
description: Vineyard Market is serving a Christmas Eve brunch with food and specials, so you can enjoy a meal out without cooking or washing dishes before the holiday festivities. It runs Thursday, December 24, 2026, from 10:30 AM to 3:00 PM at 1759 W State Hwy J in Ozark, MO. Reservations are recommended; call (417) 882-0399 or reserve online. The market closes afterward for the rest of the holiday and all of Christmas Day.
